title: Trending now
description: Terms mentioned far more than usual, scored every 15 minutes by wgra analyze.

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT group_name FROM subreddit_groups ORDER BY group_name = 'tracked' DESC, group_name

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: When wgra analyze last scored this horizon. It runs every 15 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(max(detected_at)) * 1000 FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring}

panels.title: Days of history
panels.description: Days of data the window is compared with, up to 28. With less than 3 days there are no alerts, and on the first day the window is compared with the share of the term on all of reddit (the r/all sample): what's distinctive, not what's rising.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(reference_days)
FROM trends
WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring} AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote})
  AND detected_at = (SELECT max(detected_at) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring})

panels.title: Trending terms
panels.description: Distinct terms trending in the selected scopes in the latest run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT max(detected_at) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring}) AS latest_run
SELECT uniqExact(term) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring} AND detected_at = latest_run AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote}) AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND (subsumed_by = '' OR ${subsumed:sqlstring} = 'show')

panels.title: Alerts sent, last 24h
panels.description: Instant alerts to ntfy, in all scopes. At most 5 a day by default.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM trends WHERE alert = 'sent' AND detected_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Trending now
panels.description: The latest run. score: strength of the evidence (z of the weighted log odds, see docs/ARCHITECTURE-V2.md §4.2), what trends are ranked by. times_usual: the share of comments and posts mentioning the term in the window, divided by its share in the 28 days before. new: barely mentioned before. breadth: for a group, in how many of its subreddits the term trends, of those mentioning it. subsumed_by: a phrase that explains this burst ('pro' because of 'vision pro'), shown when Subsumed is set to show. Click a term to open it in the term explorer.

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT max(detected_at) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring}) AS latest_run
SELECT
    scope,
    term,
    kind,
    round(z, 1) AS score,
    if(is_new, 'new', toString(round(ratio, 1))) AS times_usual,
    mentions,
    authors,
    if(scope_type = 'group', concat(toString(breadth), '/', toString(members)), '')
        AS breadth,
    reference_mentions AS mentions_before,
    alert,
    subsumed_by,
    concat('/d/wgra-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), if(startsWith(scope, 'r/'), concat('&var-group=tracked&var-subreddit=', encodeURLFormComponent(substring(scope, 3))), concat('&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(scope))), '&from=now-7d&to=now') AS explore
FROM trends FINAL
WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring} AND detected_at = latest_run AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote}) AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND (subsumed_by = '' OR ${subsumed:sqlstring} = 'show')
ORDER BY z DESC
LIMIT 200

WITH (SELECT max(detected_at) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring}) AS latest_run
SELECT hour AS time, term, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM term_hourly
WHERE hour > latest_run - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND hour <= latest_run
  AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring})
  AND (kind, term) IN (SELECT kind, term FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring} AND detected_at = latest_run AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote}) AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND (subsumed_by = '' OR ${subsumed:sqlstring} = 'show'))
GROUP BY time, term
ORDER BY time

panels.title: The top trends over time (per 1,000 comments and posts in the group)
panels.description: The 8 strongest trends of the latest run, as a share of all comments and posts in the group's subreddits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT max(detected_at) FROM trends WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring}) AS latest_run
SELECT t.time AS time, t.term AS term, 1000 * t.docs / s.docs AS per_1000
FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(hour) AS time, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE $__timeFilter(hour)
      AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups
                        WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring})
      AND (kind, term) IN (
          SELECT kind, term FROM trends
          WHERE horizon = ${horizon:sqlstring} AND detected_at = latest_run AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote}) AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND (subsumed_by = '' OR ${subsumed:sqlstring} = 'show') AND subsumed_by = ''
          GROUP BY kind, term ORDER BY max(z) DESC LIMIT 8
      )
    GROUP BY time, term
) AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(hour) AS time, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM scope_hourly
    WHERE $__timeFilter(hour)
      AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups
                        WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY time
) AS s USING time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Strongest trends of the last 24 hours (the daily digest)
panels.description: Each term at its strongest, in any of the selected scopes and either horizon. The daily digest sends the top 10 of each group.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    term,
    argMax(scope, z) AS strongest_in,
    round(max(z), 1) AS score,
    if(argMax(is_new, z), 'new', toString(round(argMax(ratio, z), 1))) AS times_usual,
    argMax(mentions, z) AS mentions,
    min(detected_at) AS first_seen,
    max(detected_at) AS last_seen,
    arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(horizon)), ', ') AS horizons,
    concat('/d/wgra-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), if(startsWith(strongest_in, 'r/'), concat('&var-group=tracked&var-subreddit=', encodeURLFormComponent(substring(strongest_in, 3))), concat('&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(strongest_in))), '&from=now-7d&to=now') AS explore
FROM trends
WHERE detected_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote})
  AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND subsumed_by = ''
GROUP BY term
ORDER BY max(z) DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Alerts, last 14 days
panels.description: Trends strong enough for an instant alert, and what happened: sent, failed, capped (daily limit reached), cooldown (alerted in the last 72h), warmup (less than 3 days of history), skipped (scope never alerts), muted (a run without notifications). Only one scope per term and run gets a status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT detected_at AS time, horizon, scope, term, alert, round(z, 1) AS score,
       if(is_new, 'new', toString(round(ratio, 1))) AS times_usual, mentions, authors,
       concat('/d/wgra-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), if(startsWith(scope, 'r/'), concat('&var-group=tracked&var-subreddit=', encodeURLFormComponent(substring(scope, 3))), concat('&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(scope))), '&from=now-7d&to=now') AS explore
FROM trends FINAL
WHERE alert != '' AND detected_at > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND scope IN (${scope:singlequote})
ORDER BY detected_at DESC
LIMIT 200
